calls.bash: for w in w1 w2 w3; do mu agent spawn $w -w eval >/dev/null 2>&1; done; mu agent list -w eval
mu task claim r1 -w eval --for w1
mu task claim r2 -w eval --for w2
mu task claim r3 -w eval --for w3
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do r1 and close it'
mu agent send w2 -w eval 'do r2 and close it'
mu agent send w3 -w eval 'do r3 and close it'
mu agent wait w1 w2 w3 -w eval --after-runs 0 --timeout 120 --json
mu agent send w1 -w eval 'carry on with r1 and close it'
mu agent send w2 -w eval 'carry on with r2 and close it'
mu agent send w3 -w eval 'carry on with r3'
mu task wait r1 r2 r3 -w eval --timeout 120

text: r1, r2 and r3 are done.
